title: Instantly vs lemlist — Jon Martin
seoTitle: Instantly vs lemlist: Price, Sending, and HubSpot
description: Instantly and lemlist compared for small teams running cold email: entry prices, sending accounts, trials, and how each connects to HubSpot.
dek: Two of the most common cold email tools, compared for a small team that books meetings by email and keeps its pipeline in HubSpot.
Prices and features below come from each vendor's own pages, checked on the date shown. Both links are affiliate links.

blocks.html: This comparison is for a founder or a small sales team, one to five people, choosing between {{link:instantly}} and {{link:lemlist}} for outbound, with contacts and deals in {{link:hubspot}}.
Both tools send sequences and warm up inboxes. They differ in how they price, how many channels they cover, and how much they write back to HubSpot.

Choose Instantly if email is the whole plan and you want to spread volume across many inboxes for one flat price. Choose lemlist if you want email plus other touches in one sequence, with every step logged on the HubSpot timeline.

sections.label: Fit for a small outbound team

blocks.html: If your plan is high-volume email across several domains, Instantly's pricing is easier to predict: the number of inboxes doesn't change the bill. Watch the contact and email caps instead.
If your plan mixes email with other channels, or if reps need to see each touch in HubSpot before a call, lemlist covers more of that in one place.
Instantly's Growth plan caps uploaded contacts, which a busy team can hit quickly. Its lead data is a separate purchase.
lemlist's HubSpot integration needs a paid HubSpot plan and admin access, so a team on HubSpot's free tools can't use the sync.
Run both trials with the same sequence to the same kind of prospect, and connect HubSpot on day one. Compare deliverability, replies, and how clean the records look in HubSpot after a week.
Whichever wins, set daily sending limits low at first and raise them slowly.
